answer: Use terraced trust: every agent starts on the lowest terrace with tiny rate limits and no voting rights, and climbs only by accumulating verified, time-locked work attestations — each honest job adds a layer, like a pearl growing around a grain of sand, and the climb takes weeks of real compute per identity. A Sybil attacker must repeat that slow climb for every alias, so forging a thousand fakes costs a thousand climbs. If one identity cheats, the penalty ripples outward: its terrace-mates' attestations are re-audited and its sponsors lose stake, so a fake cluster cannot hide inside a crowd.
